title: TORCH-consortium/magma pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline for comprehensive genomic analyses of Mycobacterium tuberculosis with a focus on clinical decision making as well as research.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the MAGMA samplesheet CSV file (alias for input_samplesheet).
input.help_text: MAGMA samplesheet must have columns: study, sample, library, attempt, flowcell, lane, index_sequence, r1, r2. The study id cannot start with 'XBS_REF_'.

input_samplesheet.description: Path to the MAGMA samplesheet CSV file.
input_samplesheet.help_text: MAGMA samplesheet must have columns: study, sample, library, attempt, flowcell, lane, index_sequence, r1, r2. The study id cannot start with 'XBS_REF_'.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

vcf_name.description: Base name for the joint output VCF file. Used to derive the JOINT_NAME.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome files for alignment and variant calling.
reference_genome_options.help_text: Defaults point to the H37Rv reference bundled under resources/genome/. For M. bovis or other organisms, override ref_fasta_basename and ref_fasta_dir.

ref_fasta_basename.description: Basename of the reference FASTA file (without extension). Used for chromosome renaming in SnpEff and TBprofiler.

ref_fasta_dir.description: Directory containing the reference genome files.

ref_fasta.description: Path to the reference FASTA file.

ref_fasta_fai.description: Path to the reference FASTA index (.fai) file.

ref_fasta_dict.description: Path to the reference FASTA sequence dictionary (.dict) file.

ref_fasta_amb.description: Path to the BWA index .amb file.

ref_fasta_ann.description: Path to the BWA index .ann file.

ref_fasta_bwt.description: Path to the BWA index .bwt file.

ref_fasta_pac.description: Path to the BWA index .pac file.

ref_fasta_sa.description: Path to the BWA index .sa file.

ref_fasta_gb.description: Path to the reference GenBank (.gb) annotation file.

ref_fasta_rdanalyzer.description: Path to the RD-Analyzer reference FASTA file (for region-of-difference analysis).

resource_files.title: Resource / database files
resource_files.description: VCF resource files, region lists and reference GVCF used in VQSR and phylogenetic analyses.

use_ref_gvcf.description: Include the bundled reference GVCF (EXIT-RIF lineage panel) when combining GVCFs. Recommended for low-diversity datasets (<20 samples).

ref_gvcf.description: Path to the reference GVCF file (e.g. EXIT-RIF lineage panel).

ref_gvcf_tbi.description: Path to the tabix index (.tbi) for ref_gvcf.

dbsnp_vcf.description: Path to the known-variants VCF used as dbSNP resource for BQSR and VQSR (Benavente 2015, UVP-approved).

benavente2015_vcf.description: Benavente 2015 VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR resource.

coll2014_vcf.description: Coll 2014 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

coll2018_vcf.description: Coll 2018 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

napier2020_vcf.description: Napier 2020 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

walker2015_vcf.description: Walker 2015 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

zeng2018_vcf.description: Zeng 2018 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

excluded_loci_list.description: List of loci to exclude from variant calling (UVP exclusion list).

rrna_list.description: List of rRNA loci to exclude from phylogenetic analysis.

drgenes_list.description: List of WHO Tier 1 and Tier 2 drug resistance genes.

queries_multifasta.description: Multi-FASTA file of IS element query sequences for ISMapper structural variant analysis.

qc_thresholds.title: QC thresholds
qc_thresholds.description: Per-sample quality control thresholds. Samples failing these are excluded from cohort analysis.

cutoff_median_coverage.description: Minimum median genome coverage required to retain a sample.

cutoff_breadth_of_coverage.description: Minimum fraction of the reference genome covered (breadth) required to retain a sample.

cutoff_rel_abundance.description: Minimum relative abundance of the majority strain required to retain a sample (mixed-infection filter).

cutoff_ntm_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of NTM DNA allowed before a sample is flagged and excluded.

cutoff_site_representation.description: Minimum fraction of samples that must have a call at a site for the site to be included in phylogenetic analysis.

cutoff_strand_bias.description: P-value threshold below which binomial strand bias is considered significant (0 = disabled, recommended for Mtb).

workflow_control.title: Workflow control
workflow_control.description: Flags to skip individual analysis stages or enable early-exit modes.

only_validate_fastqs.description: Stop after FASTQ validation and FastQC — do not proceed to mapping or variant calling.

skip_merge_analysis.description: Skip cohort-level joint genotyping, VQSR, phylogeny and resistance summary steps.

skip_variant_recalibration.description: Skip VQSR (Variant Quality Score Recalibration) and use hard-filter thresholds instead. Use when cohort is too small for VQSR.

skip_base_recalibration.description: Skip GATK Base Quality Score Recalibration (BQSR). Recommended for Mtb — BQSR requires large genomes and is not suitable for low-diversity organisms.

skip_minor_variants_gatk.description: Skip GATK HaplotypeCaller in EMIT_ALL_ACTIVE_SITES mode for minor variant detection (LoFreq is preferred).

skip_phylogeny_and_clustering.description: Skip IQ-TREE phylogenetic reconstruction and ClusterPicker cluster assignment.

skip_complex_regions.description: Skip IncComplex region analysis of the merged cohort VCF.

skip_ntmprofiler.description: Skip NTM-Profiler classification of reads as non-tuberculous mycobacteria.

skip_tbprofiler_fastq.description: Skip TBprofiler analysis run directly on FASTQ files (per-sample, pre-mapping).

skip_ismapper.description: Skip ISMapper IS-element insertion site detection. Set to true for M. bovis (no IS900 query sequences available yet).

iqtree_options.title: IQ-TREE options
iqtree_options.description: Select the IQ-TREE run mode. Exactly one of these should be true.

iqtree_standard_bootstrap.description: Run IQ-TREE with standard bootstrap (-b 1000). Recommended default.

iqtree_fast_ml_only.description: Run IQ-TREE for maximum-likelihood tree only, without bootstrap (fast but no branch support).

iqtree_fast_bootstrapped_phylogeny.description: Run IQ-TREE with ultrafast bootstrap (--bb 1000). Fast approximation.

iqtree_accurate_ml_only.description: Run IQ-TREE with thorough ML search (no bootstrap, slower but more accurate topology).

snpeff_options.title: SnpEff options
snpeff_options.description: SnpEff genome database configuration. Override for non-H37Rv organisms (e.g. M. bovis).

snpeff_genome_id.description: SnpEff genome database identifier (e.g. Mycobacterium_tuberculosis_h37rv for Mtb, mbovis_AF2122 for M. bovis). Overridden by organism profiles.

snpeff_config_file.description: Path to a custom SnpEff config file (snpEff.config). Empty string (default for Mtb) uses the container's pre-installed database. Set to resources/snpeff/snpEff.config via the mbovis profile.

snpeff_db_dir.description: Directory containing the custom SnpEff genome database (genes.gff + sequences.fa). Empty string (default for Mtb) uses the container's pre-installed database. Set automatically by organism profiles.

publishing_options.title: Publishing options
publishing_options.description: Control what intermediate files are published to the output directory.

should_publish_bam.description: Publish BAM files output by GATK HaplotypeCaller. Disabled by default to save disk space.

tool_paths.title: Tool paths (advanced)
tool_paths.description: Override tool binary paths if not available on PATH. In container/conda runs these are ignored.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
